PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1997
PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to repeal the
People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 18th March, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(5)/97, dated 18‑3‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the People's
Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Repeal) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Repeal of Sindh Act XIII of 1995

PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1997
PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to repeal the
People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 18th March, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(5)/97, dated 18‑3‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Repeal of Sindh Act XIII of
1995.‑‑The People's Medical College and Hospital, Nawabshah
Act, 1995, is hereby repealed.
(2) Upon the repeal of the Act‑‑
(a) the People s Medical College
and Hospital Nawabshah hereinafter referred to as the said College, shall stand
transferred to Government and on such transfer it shall be known as the Medical
College and Hospital Nawabshah and shall be managed by Government;
(b) notwithstanding anything
contained in any contract or agreement or in the conditions of service, the
officers and other employees of the said College shall stand transferred 'to
Government on such terms and conditions as may be laid down by Government;
(c) all rights, properties,
assets, debts, liabilities and obligations of the said College shall be the
rights, properties, assets, debts, liabilities and obligations of Government;
(d) any contract made by the said
College before such repeal shall be deemed to have been made by Government; and
(e) all suits and other legal
proceedings instituted by or against the said college before such repeal shall
be deemed to be suits and proceedings instituted by or against Government and
may be proceeded or otherwise dealt with accordingly.
